name: Compound
summary: The financial-hack track: payments, fraud, and small-business cash flow. Submissions must use synthetic or sandbox data; real financial records are excluded.
evidence: Track anchor steelhacks.org/tracks#compound, quoted in participant planning docs (RealityCheck, callback).

name: Xtract
summary: Turn varied incoming reports and documents into meaningful signals with source traceability and a usable output. Public or synthetic sources are allowed; LANXESS data is excluded.
evidence: Track anchor steelhacks.org/tracks#x-tract, quoted by RealityCheck, Fuego, badfaith, GutGuide.

name: Beyond the Chatbot
summary: Nemotron doing something other than chat, with a clearly explained role in the system and evidence it works (an eval, comparison, benchmark, or a documented failure). Stacks with every other track. Three winning teams, each receiving four Jetson Orin Nano Super kits, Brev credits and hats.
evidence: Track anchor steelhacks.org/tracks#nemotron; Devpost prize text; quoted by nine repos.

name: Out Loud!
summary: Voice- and audio-first products built with ElevenLabs (TTS, speech-to-text, conversational agents). Every hacker gets a month of Creator tier; the winning team gets three months of Scale.
evidence: Devpost sponsor text; heard-meeting, HelloWord, OmniSight planning docs.

name: Seed Round
summary: A real problem, a working product (not a pitch deck), and a reason to believe people want it.
evidence: Organizer wording quoted in OmniSight design doc; GutGuide and heard-meeting target it.

name: No Wrapper
summary: No language model anywhere in the finished project. Something hard in a way you can explain, and a working demo judges can try; classical machine learning is fine. Prizes: AirPods 4, a keyboard, or a bottle.
evidence: Organizer wording quoted in OmniSight design doc.

name: Cold Start
evidence: Referenced by RealityCheck and OmniSight docs; exact criteria not recoverable (steelhacks.org blocked from this sandbox).

name: Presage
summary: Use clinically-proven vital signs, movement, emotion or focus tracking. Two sub-themes: Accessibility & Security (vital-sign authentication or accessibility) and Productivity (tools that track focus or stress). Perks: free Presage credit refills and 30% off first-year usage.
evidence: Devpost and steelhacks.org snippets via web search.

name: Solana
summary: Build on the Solana network: fast execution, near-zero fees. Prizes: Ledger Nano S Plus devices.

name: MLH bonus tracks
summary: Best Use of Gemini API, Tiger Data, Snowflake, DigitalOcean ($200 credits), .Tech domain (Best Domain Name), ElevenLabs.
evidence: OmniSight and GutGuide planning docs; DigitalOcean credit text on Devpost.

name: General (no sponsor track)
summary: Projects that do not target a sponsor track: games, tools, campus utilities.
evidence: Assigned by the judge where no official track fits.
